THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: A production possibilities frontier shows the combinations of two goods an economy can produce with its current resources and technology. A bowed-out PPF shows increasing opportunity cost as resources are shifted toward one good. Opportunity cost rises because resources are specialized and become less well suited as they are shifted into the other good. A PPF shows possible production combinations given current resources and technology.
